title: Renormalization Group and Critical Phenomena
relevance: Foundational paper on the renormalization group in physics; provides the theoretical framework for coarse-graining dynamics across scales, adapted here to residue class analysis.

title: The 3x+1 problem and its generalizations
relevance: Comprehensive survey of the Collatz conjecture establishing key results on residue class behavior and stopping times that motivate the RG approach.

title: Self-similarity in the Collatz conjecture
relevance: Directly studies self-similar structure in Collatz dynamics, providing empirical and theoretical evidence for the scale-invariant phenomena this concept formalizes via RG.
